description: This file defines an interface 'IAuditService' and its implementation 'AuditService' for recording audit entries asynchronously within an application. The service interacts with a database context to store audit logs.

classes.name: AuditService
classes.description: Implementation of the IAuditService interface that records audit entries into the database asynchronously.

methods.name: RecordAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously records an audit entry into the database and saves the changes.
